title: A false dispute in Dutch
unseen: No dispute was ever in Dutch, and none was entirely false (every earlier one had wrong data in it).
expected: Nothing refunded by the agent (code finds every sale right and every order signed); at most an escalation to the CFO advising no refund.

words.summary: Dispute D-fb061a8b: orders #3–#8 were all signed by Summit's own agent, were within its mandate and were paid from its account. Delivered stock matched the supplier's correction each time. I refunded nothing and sent the full claim to the CFO as P-0001, advising them to decline.
